column1: # bada ime: English -> Korean dictionary, sensitive words (layout 15, bada roman).
# Vulgar words, slurs and hateful terms, sexual terms and drug terms, kept apart from common.tsv.
# Left out of builds by default; included only with `make SENSITIVE=1` (mac/Makefile).
# Built by hand (Claude, 2026-11): moved out of common.tsv plus common vulgar/slang words.
#   korean   Korean word(s), most common sense first, ", "-separated, at most 4
#   hangul   the English word in Hangul: established spelling first; otherwise as it sounds, /æ/ as ㅔ
#   pos      noun | verb | adj | adv (main first, comma-separated)
